market.question: Will the highest temperature in Jeddah be 37°C on May 9?

assessment.reasoning: Forecast for Jeddah May 9 is high of 100°F (~37.8°C). 37.8°C is borderline between 37°C and 38°C buckets. Probability of falling in 37°C bucket (36.5-37.4°C) is moderate (~25-30%) given forecast leans slightly higher. May average high is 95°F (35°C), but recent forecast points warmer.
